links.outcome: Endoscopist detection rate, reading time, and stress with versus without CNN screening
links.effect: Trainee detection rates did not differ significantly: A 77%, B 67%, C 79%. Reading time was 33.6 min without CNN vs 23.1 (existing) and 10.1 (novel). Stress was 3.2, 2.8, and 1.8.
links.quote: The detection rates of abnormalities by trainee endoscopists were not significantly different across the three processes: A, 77%; B, 67%; and C, 79%.

links.outcome: Head-to-head comparison of two CNN systems' clinical utility on the same SBCE videos
links.effect: Both systems extracted all 43 lesions. The novel CNN captured 9.4% of images vs 24.3% for the existing one, giving the shortest reading time (10.1 vs 23.1 min).
links.quote: CNN performance directly affects clinical utility and should be carefully assessed.

screen.reason: The study compares human reader performance, reading time, and stress under unassisted reading versus AI pre-screening workflows.

primary.practice: AI-assisted screening workflow vs unassisted reading
